title: ngrok AI Gateway translation removals per model
description: Each field that translation writes for an API and that a provider or model refuses on that API. The AI Gateway drops the field before it sends the request. Generated by `nd gen docs` in the ngrok monorepo.

model.description: The model ID. Empty when every model of the provider on the surface refuses the field.

reason.description: provider: the provider does not take the field on the surface. model: the model refuses the field.
